strategy.name: Inherited nuclei plus old marginal provinces and dated gateways
strategy.reason: The six-body design target passes dated geometry, bounded physical tests, and the first explicit crustal-block/finite-rotation audit without requiring Strategy B. Broad JX1, C4 and shelf-head polygons are now interpreted primarily as inherited/reworked continental substrate rather than wholly young accreted crust.

motion_policy.alternate_frame_role: MULLER2022 is an explicit sensitivity check; it is not silently mixed into the primary reconstruction.
motion_policy.rule: Rigid nuclei use inherited rotation circuits; broad collisional/junction regions are deforming networks. All authored gateway-forming rigid-block rotations finish by 2 Ma or earlier. Later uplift, subsidence, boundary slip, erosion, volcanism, glaciation and sea-level response may continue.

notes: JX1 is a broad junction-province surface envelope containing mostly old/reworked substrate plus a narrower younger arc/suture system.
The C4 corridor is mainly inherited foreland/microcontinental substrate reorganized by younger collision, not ~3.75 million km2 of newly generated crust.
C5_SHELF_HEAD is a legacy feature name; its kinematic parent is the C3 southeast shelf block rather than the C5 nucleus.
The two eastern stepping blocks reach final shelf-relative orientations by 2 Ma, before the 1.9 Ma human-route motion cutoff.

unresolved_constraints.question: What time-dependent ice and local climate solution produces the bounded C4 peripheral-refugia behavior?
unresolved_constraints.current_evidence: The 32-46S corridor passes simplified ice/refugia and plate-parentage tests without requiring a polar-interior route.
unresolved_constraints.stop_condition: Do not redraw C4 unless a higher-fidelity ice/elevation model specifically fails the corridor.

unresolved_constraints.question: What local relative-sea-level and sill history realizes H06/H07/H10 northern accessibility states?
unresolved_constraints.current_evidence: A -70 m class sill scenario and stable C1-C3 parent-block relationship produce the required distinct windows without late continent assembly.
unresolved_constraints.stop_condition: Resolve with bathymetry, eustasy, isostasy and geoid sensitivity; do not invent new continent-scale motion.

unresolved_constraints.question: What current, wind, bathymetric and voyage solution realizes the repaired eastern crossing network?
unresolved_constraints.current_evidence: Regenerated water gaps are about 54.7, 28.3 and 75.0 km; stepping blocks finish relative motion by 2 Ma and remain separated by deep sills.
unresolved_constraints.stop_condition: Resolve with local bathymetric sections and voyage/current modeling; do not add islands unless that model specifically fails.

unresolved_constraints.question: What detailed C3 relief, drainage and hydroclimate produce the intermittent-contact state machine?
unresolved_constraints.current_evidence: C3 rigid-core/shelf partition and bounded pass/plateau states permit limited contact and strong restriction without universal bypass.
unresolved_constraints.stop_condition: Resolve with deforming-suture relief, drainage and climate reconstruction, not coastline changes unless specifically required.

unresolved_constraints.question: Can the exact crustal-thickness, deformation and freeboard history generate all six final envelopes while conserving continental crust?
unresolved_constraints.current_evidence: The explicit plate-block model passes inherited-circuit, synthetic rotation-speed, pre-1.9 Ma motion, crust-provenance and global crust-area accounting tests. About 158.6 million km2 of emerged land fits within a ~210.4 million km2 Earth-analogue continental-crust inventory without net crust creation.
unresolved_constraints.stop_condition: Build spatial crustal-thickness/stretching grids, deforming meshes and a time-indexed freeboard model. Invoke Strategy B only if a genuine C1-C2 kinematic incompatibility survives local deforming-network repair.

fallback_strategy.trigger: Use only if a later spatial plate/deforming-mesh reconstruction exposes a C1-C2 incompatibility that cannot be repaired locally within Strategy A.
fallback_strategy.description: Promote the C1-C2 junction to a separately reconstructed microplate system and permit modest pre-1.9 Ma rotations of both adjacent bodies around it.
fallback_strategy.retry_limit: one materially different fallback after Strategy A; preserve best valid state if B also fails
